extracted_text: The AI world is abuzz again as industry leaders argue about whether we’ve crossed a pivotal threshold in artificial intelligence. On August 6, 2026, Axios highlighted a bold move at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis is shifting from day-to-day leadership to a broader, strategic role as chief scientist and chair, signaling a new era in how big AI orgs manage rapid breakthroughs. While some technologists hail this as a necessary pivot, others warn that the pace of advancement may outstrip governance...
